preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: All k input strings have exactly n lowercase Latin letters each.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= k <= 2500 and 2 <= n <= 5000 and sum(len(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) <= 5000
preconditions.description: k and n satisfy 1 ≤ k ≤ 2500, 2 ≤ n ≤ 5000, and the total length of all strings (k·n) does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) == n and all(len(s) == n for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', it is a string of length n (the candidate original string s), and all input strings have length n.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' implies all(any((s_i[i] == s[j] and s_i[j] == s[i] and i != j) or (s_i[i] == s[i] and s_i[j] == s[j] and i != j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j) for s_i in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: For every input string s_i, there exists exactly one pair of indices (i, j) where s_i differs from s by a swap of characters at positions i and j (i ≠ j).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' implies not all(any((s_i[i] == s[j] and s_i[j] == s[i] and i != j) or (s_i[i] == s[i] and s_i[j] == s[j] and i != j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j) for s_i in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If stdout is '-1', no candidate string s of length n can produce all input strings by swapping exactly two characters in each.
